items.summary: Remove AppX packaging and runtime dead code (#20681)
items.fullMessage:
Remove AppX packaging and runtime dead code (#20681)

Closes #18799
See also #16498
Summary of the issue:

NVDA is no longer built or distributed as an AppX package for the Windows Store. Any future distribution to the Microsoft Store will use MSIX rather than AppX (see Microsoft MSIX packaging documentation). As a result, build targets, runtime package detection, and conditional code paths specific to AppX are dead code that add unnecessary complexity and maintenance overhead.
Description of user facing changes:

None.
Description of developer facing changes:

    Removed config.isAppX variable.
    Removed gui.blockAction.Context.WINDOWS_STORE_VERSION enum member.
    Removed the appx SCons build alias and targets (appx_storeSubmission, appx_sideLoadable).

Description of development approach:

    Build System:
        Deleted the appx/ directory containing manifest.xml.subst, sconscript, and appx_images/.
        Removed appx_storeSubmission, appx_sideLoadable, and the appx alias from sconstruct.
        Cleaned up the SHA256 code signing comment in sconstruct.
    Process Startup & Lifecycle:
        Removed runtime Windows Store package detection (GetCurrentPackageFullName) from source/nvda.pyw.
        Simplified Ease of Access notification calls in source/nvda.pyw during startup and exit.
        Removed onQueryEndSession restart registration and wx.EVT_QUERY_END_SESSION event binding from source/core.py.
    Configuration & Subsystems:
        Removed isAppX = False from source/config/__init__.py.
        Removed _appx directory suffix logic from config.getUserDefaultConfigPath() and made "addons" subdirectory creation unconditional in config.initConfigPath().
        Excised config.isAppX conditional checks from source/NVDAHelper/__init__.py (remote injection and IA2 termination), source/addonHandler/__init__.py, source/addonHandler/packaging.py, source/addonStore/dataManager.py, source/brailleTables/__init__.py, source/touchHandler.py, and source/updateCheck.py.
        Cleaned up unused imports across affected modules.
    GUI & Action Blocking:
        Removed WINDOWS_STORE_VERSION from gui.blockAction.Context enum and updated when() docstring.
        Removed Context.WINDOWS_STORE_VERSION decorator arguments from globalCommands.py (script_activatePythonConsole) and gui/__init__.py (onAddonStoreCommand, onAddonStoreUpdatableCommand).
        Removed config.isAppX conditionals from Tools menu items creation in gui/__init__.py.
        Removed AppX checks from source/gui/addonGui.py (handleRemoteAddonInstall), source/gui/exit.py (ExitDialog), source/gui/settingsDialogs.py (developer scratchpad controls), and source/gui/startupDialogs.py (start after logon checkbox).
        Cleaned up docstrings in source/NVDAObjects/IAccessible/sysListView32.py.
